assets.name: button-red-wash
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: true transparent watercolor brush stroke fill for a destructive action button. The attached small red delete button is the STYLE and COLOR reference only. Generate ONLY the red painted shape WITHOUT ANY TEXT. Wide horizontal 3:1 composition. A single warm coral/terracotta red (#c95f54 to #de8572) watercolor brush stroke rectangle, with subtly uneven dry-brush edges and tiny pigment gaps at the upper and lower border, very slightly angled/chamfered ends like the reference. The central broad region is opaque and evenly medium red so white text placed later will be readable. Shape fills nearly all width and 85% of height with a small transparent margin. Hand-painted watercolor mottling, gentle color variation. TRUE TRANSPARENT exterior, no white or paper rectangle, no lettering, icon, UI mockup, shadow, 3D effect, frame, border or watermark.

assets.name: forest-header-clear-desktop
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production background wallpaper for the study website. Image 1 is the existing forest wallpaper used as STYLE and PALETTE reference. Preserve its airy warm ivory watercolor paper, pale sage/olive forest trees, muted yellow-green grasses, tiny cream daisies and soft hand-painted pigment. Generate a NEW composition with a CLEAR HEADER SAFE AREA. The specified entire upper blank band must be uninterrupted warm ivory paper all the way from the left edge to the right edge: absolutely no branches, leaves, trees, petals, floating objects, lines or scenery in that band. All foliage starts BELOW the blank band and stays in the far side margins; do NOT paint a canopy at top corners. Below the blank band, keep the central 80–84% of the width empty ivory paper for UI. Delicate natural-proportion pale trees and leaves along the left and right edges, softly painted meadow and tiny daisies along bottom edge. Low contrast calm watercolor, organic edge shapes, consistent with reference. No text, UI, logo, character, books, frame, border or watermark. Opaque full bleed ivory background. Desktop landscape 1536 x 1024, 3:2 aspect. TOP 22% OF THE ENTIRE CANVAS MUST BE COMPLETELY BLANK IVORY PAPER. Below that, side foliage occupies only the outermost 10% on each side. Trees fade inward delicately. Bottom meadow roughly 7% high.
